correctness.rationale: Exact OU generator, empirical moment ratios and the Gaussian polar factorization establish a_m+2=2/(R²U). Since 1/m≤U≤1 and R² is chi-square_m, every positive inverse moment has the sharp strict threshold m>2q. Polynomial degree then gives the two different propagation moment cutoffs, and explicit integration of the true Koopman image gives the squared-risk threshold. Small-ball chi-square constants yield both sharp Pareto tails. 78095 rational finite-checker assertions passed; infinite results rely on proof.

value.rationale: A mathematically natural, noninvariant OU quadratic observable gives a precise method-selection warning: finite-data Richardson polynomial order changes squared-risk integrability and sample complexity without making the empirical Gram singular. The exact m/8 versus m/4 tails quantify rare-event severity, and the SDMD-2 h=1 cancellation separates semigroup-Taylor from generator-polynomial schemes. The scope is explicit and the finding does not claim altered typical-case accuracy or general failure.
